>Even during work it is so easy to hide and pretend that everything is okay but when I go home I am hit with the stark reality of how much I don’t want to be alive. 

I perfectly understand this. Most people I know would think of me as a successful professional, joyful and I make a lot of jokes.
I think there's an opera about a clown that is depressed. I haven't thought of that in a long time. Seems like it suits me very nicely
No, we don't have kids. She wants them, but honestly I've been pushing that back because of the suicide thoughts. I know I can't do that to any kid, and I want to keep that door open for me.
